title: The Ashby Ring
brief: Lady Ashby's ring vanished during her dinner party. Five people have given statements. Each is true apart from a few words that have been flipped to their opposites. Put every statement right and the thief will be obvious.
evidence: Dinner ended at 22:00. Coffee was then served downstairs in the library until 22:30.
It began to rain at 21:30 and rained all night.
At 21:45 Lady Ashby locked her ring in the upstairs study. At 22:30 it was gone.
Whoever took the ring left wet footprints across the study carpet.
The back stairs are the only way upstairs. They start in the kitchen, beside the back door to the garden.
In the Major's coat pocket: a pawnbroker's ticket for his medals, and an unpaid gambling bill for £400.

statements.text: From 22:00 I served coffee in the library. Miss Clara and Lady Ashby never left the fire. The Major slipped out at 22:05 and came back at 22:15 with his collar [[dry|*wet]]. Between ourselves, the Major is [[rich|*poor]] these days, whatever he pretends.
I went [[inside|*outside]] for a cigar, and I didn't bother with an umbrella. I came back to the library by the [[front|*back]] door.
I went up to lock my ring away at 21:45, [[after|*before]] dinner ended. The rain was [[*already|not yet]] falling. I was the [[last|*first]] person to climb the back stairs that night.

Only two people went up the back stairs tonight. Lady Ashby went up at 21:45. The other went up twenty-five minutes [[earlier|*later]]. My back was turned, but I heard the back door bang and found a trail of rainwater from it to the stairs. Rook's boots sat [[*dry|wet]] by my stove all evening.
I came in from the greenhouse at 21:20, [[*before|after]] the rain started, and set my boots by the stove. Whoever left that trail of rainwater, it [[was|*wasn't]] me.

file.text: Major Fenn. Someone came in dripping from the garden at 22:10 and climbed the back stairs. The Major was the only one missing from the library then, and Rook's boots were dry.
He slipped out to the garden at 22:05, came back in through the kitchen door at 22:10 and went up the back stairs, the only way to the study, leaving rainwater all the way.
Money. The Major is broke: his medals are at the pawnbroker's and he owes £400 in gambling debts.

solution: Major Fenn took the ring. Only two people climbed the back stairs: Lady Ashby at 21:45, and someone dripping wet twenty-five minutes later, at 22:10. The only person missing from the library at 22:10 was the Major, out in the rain with no umbrella. Rook came in at 21:20, before the rain, and his boots stayed dry, so the wet footprints aren't his. He needed the money: his medals were already pawned to cover his gambling debts.
